name: Trading Economics API
rate_limits: Trial: 100 data requests and 100,000 data points (source: https://tradingeconomics.com/api/pricing.aspx).
history_start: Calendar history by date range on paid plans.
what_it_has: Economic calendar with actual, previous, consensus forecast and its own forecast, plus indicators and market data for many countries.
simple: A paid service with economic numbers and forecasts for almost every country.
license_terms: Paid subscription only. The trial fee is not refundable and renews automatically unless cancelled. https://tradingeconomics.com/api/pricing.aspx
quality_notes: The free guest:guest login now returns HTTP 410, the guest account has been discontinued (tested 2026-10-20). Unknown whether stored forecasts are as known before each release.

relevance.reason: Paid only, so out of reach on a zero budget.
